chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'When a Muslim is weak, let him eat meat with milk.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Title of Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali recommend for a Muslim suffering from physical weakness?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi conveys a statement by Amir Al-Mu'minin (Imam Ali, peace be upon him) regarding dietary recommendations for maintaining health. It advises that when a Muslim experiences physical weakness, consuming meat along with milk is a beneficial remedy to restore strength. In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often interpreted through the lens of *al-Tibb al-Nabawi* (Prophetic Medicine), highlighting the synergistic nutritional value of combining animal protein with dairy to combat fatigue and restore vitality.
